title: Work Order
description: An executable work order for the Slice 1a execution layer. The runner operator/run.sh consumes this, invokes a builder in a detached worktree, and independently verifies every claim the builder makes.

pr_opener.description: Optional. A command run after an ACCEPTED verdict to open the pull request. It receives the run directory as $1 and must print the PR reference on stdout. Omitted means the run stops at result.json, which is the default and what Slice 1a did before this field existed. It is a field rather than a hardcoded `gh pr create` on purpose: opening a PR is the first outward-facing act in the whole pipeline, and it should require someone to write it down.
